rationale: Correct the existing Hill Top Energy Center record in place using direct manager and regulatory evidence. Ardian Americas Infrastructure Funds acquired 41.9% in July 2019 and reached 100% in April 2025. Blackstone announced a definitive acquisition agreement on September 15, 2025, FERC authorized the proposed transfer on March 19, 2026, and the direct FERC consummation notice establishes that the transaction closed on March 26, 2026. A June 2026 filing continues to identify Hill Top as an indirect wholly owned Blackstone subsidiary. Update Blackstone's entry to the legal close, add Ardian as a realized former owner, replace the obsolete pending-transaction judgment, preserve one plant-company boundary and add direct closing evidence. Public sources do not disclose Hill Top's separate corporate headquarters, founding year or standalone website, or the internal allocation of the remaining 9% among other Blackstone-affiliated vehicles. No later sale or signed pending transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Hill Top Energy Center
beforeImage.description: Hill Top Energy Center is a combined-cycle natural gas power plant in western Pennsylvania. The facility supplies electricity into the PJM market and is positioned near large commercial and data center power demand in the region. Its operating model is asset-heavy and tied to wholesale power generation, with value driven by plant efficiency, dispatch profile, and local market conditions. Public disclosures describe Hill Top as a 620 megawatt plant and one of the newer and more efficient combined-cycle facilities in Pennsylvania. Blackstone announced an agreement to acquire the asset from Ardian in September 2025, and detailed ownership percentages were not publicly disclosed.

milestones.event: Hill Top Energy Center entered commercial operation in western Pennsylvania.
Blackstone announced an agreement to acquire Hill Top Energy Center from Ardian.

afterImage.name: Hill Top Energy Center
afterImage.description: Hill Top Energy Center is a 620 MW natural-gas combined-cycle power plant in Carmichaels, Pennsylvania that sells energy and capacity into PJM. Ardian Americas Infrastructure Funds acquired a 41.9% co-control interest in July 2019 while the plant was under construction, and the facility entered commercial operation in July 2021. Ardian acquired the remaining interest in April 2025. Blackstone announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hill Top on September 15, 2025, and a direct FERC consummation notice establishes that the transaction closed on March 26, 2026. Hill Top is now indirectly wholly owned through affiliated Blackstone funds, including Blackstone Energy Transition Partners IV AIV L.P. and BXE IV (LUX) AIV SCSp. The FERC record identifies 76.28% and 14.72% aggregator interests for those two vehicles; the internal allocation of the remaining 9% among other affiliated vehicles is not publicly disclosed. The plant company is the canonical PortCo, while buyer and seller holding entities are not counted separately. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.
